items.question: Do you work with our specific product category?
items.answer: We have run campaigns across auto components, textiles, industrial equipment, and other manufacturing categories. During onboarding we map your product to the right buyer profile in your target markets.

items.question: How do you make sure buyers are serious and not just price shopping?
items.answer: We target named procurement heads, sourcing managers, and importers directly, based on company size and buying signals, instead of broadcasting to anyone who fills a form on a B2B portal.

items.question: Which countries and regions can you target?
items.answer: We have run outreach across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia. Tell us your target markets and we build the prospect list and messaging around them.

items.question: Do you handle the language and cultural side of outreach in different markets?
items.answer: Yes. Messaging tone and structure are adjusted per region, and we can localise outreach where needed so it reads naturally to buyers in that market.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

items.question: What happens once we get an interested buyer? Do you help close the deal?
items.answer: We hand over every qualified meeting with full context on the buyer and their requirements, so your team can focus entirely on the relationship and the close.
